sample_unit: model responses per LLM (21 procedures x 4 queries)

links.outcome: CPT code accuracy of LLM outputs against correct codes for simple foot and ankle procedures
links.effect: Perplexity 92.9% (95% CI 87.4%-98.4%) versus Deepseek V3 48.2% (95% CI 37.5%-58.9%); significant differences among models (P < .001).
links.quote: Perplexity achieved the highest accuracy (92.9%, 95% CI = 87.4%-98.4%), whereas Deepseek V3 performed worst (48.2%, 95% CI = 37.5%-58.9%).

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs as first-pass aids for CPT/billing code assignment with human verification of codes

screen.reason: Evaluates the raw accuracy of 5 LLMs on generating CPT codes for orthopaedic foot and ankle procedures across standardized prompts without testing a deployment guardrail.
